objects.source: V on real Euclidean R^d; pi proportional to exp(-V); p_eta(y)=argmin_x[V(x)+norm(x-y)^2/(2 eta)]; H_y(G)=grad V(p_eta(y)+sqrt(eta) G); G standard Gaussian.

domains.source: Original finite Euclidean source. Standard Gaussian expectation over G; true RGO posterior and standardized r_y are different laws. Finite real Hilbert/Borel including dimension zero is a possible explicit representation extension, not literal source wording.

quantifiers.source: eta>0; every y,u. Equivalent directional presentation: every real vector a and every signed real t, u=t*a, including t=0 and a=0. Same eta for retained input/noise comparisons. No eta<=1 analytic restriction for Lemma4.2.

hypotheses.source: Global C2 V and pointwise alpha I <= Hess V <= beta I; normalized beta=1, alpha=kappa^-1 and kappa>=1. Proximal existence/measurability, probability law, first moment, centered exponential integrability and Lipschitz facts are dependencies to derive, not extra public output certificates.

conclusions.source: m_y=E_gamma H_y; b_eta(y)=m_y-g_eta(y); xi_eta(y;G)=H_y(G)-m_y, so E xi=0. Printed E exp(inner(u,xi)) <= exp(eta*norm(u)^2/2). Directional form E exp(t*inner(a,H_y-m_y)) <= exp(eta*t^2*norm(a)^2/2). First Bochner moment and every signed exponential L1 must be genuine, not inferred from a totalized integral.
